purpose: Teach: ルノー/葛飾/ジャッキー/ポーカー/ドラクエ/マスターズ/ワンセグ/スペースシャトル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルノーの車に乗せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to take you for a ride in his Renault.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Soft opening. Gentle cadence, like sharing something she knows will delight him. No rush. Tender observation in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと葛飾の柴又に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to Katsushika with Dad — to Shibamata.
lines.style: Quick, bright burst of excitement. Words tumble slightly. Pride in the memory. Wants her to know what he did. Small-boy certainty in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジャッキーチェンの映画を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you a Jackie Chan film.
lines.style: Same warm tone as before. Slightly slower — savoring the fact that he'll love this. Eyes-crinkling kind of gentle. Watching his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ポーカーはまだ早いって言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said I'm still too young for poker.
lines.style: Dry, understated. Matter-of-fact about the disappointment. A hint of wry amusement — he's already learned what he can and can't do. Small and knowing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがドラクエの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a Dragon Quest picture book.
lines.style: Same warm, gentle rhythm. A touch more playful this time — she's enjoying the parade of things his father does. Soft, like a small ritual being recounted.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマスターズの中継観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch the Masters tournament with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful, direct. A wish stated clearly. Earnest desire without pleading. Small-boy certainty mixed with genuine want. Straightforward and sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワンセグTVを持ってらしたのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has a one-seg TV with him.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before delivering this. Recognition of why this matters — he can watch what he wants. Knowing tone. Quiet satisfaction that the answer is already there.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスペースシャトルの本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a space shuttle book with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, clear, direct. The joy of the moment held in his voice. Completeness and contentment. Close and intimate — trusting her with this small happiness. Genuine warmth.
